name: Hand of Stone (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School transmutation [earth]; Level shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a small pebble)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round/level

Your hand turns into fully-flexible stone. You gain a 1d6 slam attack. It cannot be used to make multiple attacks in a round, even if your base attack bonus is +6 or higher. If it is the only attack made in a round you may apply 1-1/2 your Strength modifier to the damage.

Otherwise, the slam can be made as a secondary attack in a full-attack action at a -5 penalty. Additionally, while the spell is active, you gain a +6 bonus to Strength checks for the purposes of the slam attack, grapple checks, and sundering or damaging items with the slam.
